title: Swakaryam Sambhava Bahulam
overview: When Ravi's daughter's husband, Pushparajan, mysteriously disappears, Ravi initially doesn't want to get involved, but eventually starts to investigate. As he digs deeper, he discovers a web of secrets and lies that threaten to tear his family apart.

songs.title: Pen Katte (From "Swakaryam Sambhavabahulam")
songs.singers: Sidhartha Pradeep, Sreejish Subramanian, Sruthy Sivadas
